import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().strip().split()

n = int(data[0])
k = int(data[1])

# Calculate the maximum possible inversions (messiness)
# In a fully reversed array of size n, the number of inversions is n * (n - 1) / 2
max_inversions = n * (n - 1) // 2

# The maximum messiness is the minimum of the number of swaps we have time for (k)
# and the total possible inversions (max_inversions)
# If k is large enough to fully reverse the array, use max_inversions
# Otherwise, we can only create k inversions by making k swaps
result = min(k, max_inversions)

print(result)
